# LaplandNature

> Finnish Lapland's arctic wilderness: five national parks, the longest aurora season in Europe, the kaamos polar night, and hiking trails from 5 km to 82 km.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laplandnature.com/): Aurora, national parks and wildlife guide
- [Northern Lights](https://laplandnature.com/northern-lights): Aurora science and viewing in Lapland
- [National Parks](https://laplandnature.com/national-parks): The national parks of Finnish Lapland
- [Wildlife](https://laplandnature.com/wildlife): Arctic wildlife of Lapland
- [Bear Kuusamo](https://laplandnature.com/bear-kuusamo): Ethical bear watching in Finland
- [Seasons](https://laplandnature.com/seasons): The seasons of the far north
- [Hiking Trails](https://laplandnature.com/hiking-trails): Hiking trails in Finnish Lapland
- [Conservation](https://laplandnature.com/conservation): Conservation in Lapland
- [Freshwater](https://laplandnature.com/freshwater): Rivers and lakes of Lapland

## Languages

English (default, no prefix), Finnish (/fi/), Swedish (/sv/), German (/de/), French (/fr/), Spanish (/es/), Italian (/it/), Dutch (/nl/), Brazilian Portuguese (/br/), Japanese (/ja/), Korean (/kr/), Simplified Chinese (/cn/)
